\newcommand{\SweepResultsNe}{ The \SwNeN{} weakened norepinephrine edits would cost \SwNeCostMin--\SwNeCostMax{} nats per reading at the readout closest to their estimate (\SwNeNotReached{} never reach it), all above the budget.}
